shared.didntGetItPrefix: Didn't get it? Check your spam folder, or
shared.microcopy: We never store your email content. SOC 2 in progress. GDPR-friendly.

login.title: Sign in
login.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
login.magicLinkSentLead: We sent a magic link to {email}. Click the link to sign in. It expires in 60 minutes.
login.magicLinkIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a magic link. No password needed.

signup.title: Create your workspace
signup.errorPasswordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.
signup.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
signup.submittingSub: This can take a few seconds while we send your confirmation email.
signup.sentLead: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account. It expires in 60 minutes.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send a reset link. The link expires in 60 minutes.
forgot.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
forgot.sentLead: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent a reset link. Click it to choose a new password. It expires in 60 minutes.

reset.expiredBody: This password reset link has expired or has already been used. Reset links are valid for 60 minutes and can only be used once.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Pick a strong password for your account. You'll use it to sign in from now on.
reset.errorPasswordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters.
reset.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
reset.successBody: Your password has been changed. Redirecting you to sign in…

authorize.title: Authorize {clientName}?
authorize.preApproved: You've previously authorized this app. Confirm below to issue a new token.
authorize.willBeAbleTo: This agent will be able to:
authorize.noScopes: No specific permissions requested. This connection gets read-only access (list and search inboxes, read emails) by default.
authorize.allInboxesDesc: Access every inbox in your workspace, including ones you connect later.
authorize.specificInboxesDesc: Only the inboxes you select below.
authorize.nameConnectionHint: Shown in your dashboard so you can revoke it later.
authorize.grantingAccessTo: Granting access to {count} of {total} {total, plural, one {inbox} other {inboxes}}
authorize.connectedBody: It can now access {grantCount} of your {totalInboxes} inboxes. You'll see its calls live in your dashboard.
authorize.connectedBodyAll: It can now access all your inboxes, including ones you connect later. You'll see its calls live in your dashboard.
authorize.connectedNote: The MCP client will receive its bearer token automatically via the redirect. You can revoke access at any time from the API Keys page.
authorize.failedGeneric: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
authorize.microcopy: mcpemails never reveals your provider credentials to {clientName}. Revoke this connection from the API Keys page at any time.

fastmail.title: Connect Fastmail
fastmail.subtitle: App password connection
fastmail.callout: Use a Fastmail <link>app password</link>, not your main Fastmail password. App passwords can be revoked individually without changing your account password.
fastmail.errorNetwork: A network error occurred. Please check your connection and try again.
fastmail.hint: In Fastmail: Settings → Privacy & Security → App Passwords → New app password. Select Mail (IMAP/SMTP) access.

invite.heading: You've been invited
invite.body: {inviter} invited you to join {workspace} as a {role}.
invite.emailMismatch: ⚠ This invite was sent to {inviteEmail}. You're signed in as {userEmail}. Please sign in with the correct account to accept.
invite.errorAccept: Failed to accept invite. Please try again.

error.missingCode: This sign-in link is invalid or has already been used. Links can only be clicked once.
error.linkExpired: This sign-in link has expired. Links are valid for 60 minutes, so please request a new one.
error.sessionMissing: Your session could not be established. This can happen if cookies are blocked in your browser.
error.generic: Something went wrong while signing you in. Please try again. If the problem persists, contact support.
error.title: Sign-in failed
